metadata.case_name: TONG YUK TAI v. CHEW SOOI KUEN

plaintiff.occupation_before: majority owner of a shop selling, inter alia, second-hand prestigious watches; watch technician receiving a monthly salary

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the neck
source: soft tissue injury to the neck
right neck muscle swelling with tenderness
tenderness of right neck muscle and reduced range of motion of the neck
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

manifestations.description: on-and-off neck pain, particularly during change of weather
neck pain being aggravated by bending the neck or the neck staying immobile for 15 minutes
reduced range of motion of the neck
on-and-off pin prick sensation over right little finger
increased neck pain when lifting heavy objects
waking up 4 to 5 times a week due to neck pain

treatments_received: A&E attendance at Pok Oi Hospital

losses.description: Neck pain and stiffness, reduced neck movement, right little finger numbness and reduced endurance for prolonged neck postures and heavy lifting caused by the soft tissue injury to the neck

comparable_cases.case_name: Li Ting Fai v Woo Chi Keung
comparable_cases.injury_description: whiplash injury to the neck resulting in neck pain and stiffness; received about 48 sessions of physiotherapy; intermittent sick leave; neck X-ray revealed degenerative changes; persistent numbness and neck pain; depression and insomnia

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Kin Hung v Chan Wai Ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: sprained neck injury with intermittent residual neck pain after physiotherapy
